_doc: MC lines for AFTERCODE Final: Build Your Cast. 'cap' = Roman Hinglish caption, 'tts' = what Liam reads (Hindi in Devanagari, English words in English); phrase punctuation must match. 'at' = where the line starts, as a segment of src/config/plan.json (the measured beat plan) + a beat inside it; scripts/audio/mix.py places it there. No timing.py relayout: the picture's timeline is the music's. Claims: docs/factcheck.md (original characters, no real faces). Pronunciation fixes (checked with Scribe + faster-whisper): 'neta' is spelled नैता (नेता came out 'nita'); 'diss' is not spoken (TTS 'dis' = 'this'), the DISS BATTLE cards carry it.
